package.description: A user friendly program for uploading photos into a user's (or contact's) thumbnailPhoto attribute in Active Directory. The images in this attribute are used by Outlook 2010 and several other new Microsoft products to display images of users.

en-US.description: A user friendly program for uploading photos into a user's (or contact's) thumbnailPhoto attribute in Active Directory. The images in this attribute are used by Outlook 2010 and several other new Microsoft products to display images of users.
en-US.longDescription:
Outlook 2010, Lync, and Sharepoint can display a photo for each user account or contact in Active Directory but includes no way to upload images into the "thumbnailPhoto" Active Directory attribute that is used to store these images other than the command line tools included with Exchange 2010. AD Photo Edit is a user friendly application designed to make it easy to upload, edit, and export these images.

Free Edition Features
- Quick and easy way to view existing images for any number of users or contacts, with the option to limit search results by OU and other attributes
- Export any existing images to JPG file
- Remove existing images
- Upload new images to user accounts or contacts in your domain (or specify an alternate domain to connect to)
- Easily rotate, resize and adjust the quality of images before uploading them
- Does not limit images to being less than 10 KB in size like the Exchange 2010 command line tools
- Works with all versions of Exchange Server
- Choose to upload to the thumbnailPhoto attribute (used by Outlook & Lync) or jpegPhoto attribute (used by third party applications)
en-US.name: AD Photo Edit Free Edition

zh-CN.description: 一款用户友好的程序，用于将照片上传至 Active Directory 中用户（或联系人）的 thumbnailPhoto 属性。该属性中的图像会被 Outlook 2010 及其他多款微软新产品用于显示用户头像。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Outlook 2010、Lync 和 SharePoint 可为 Active Directory 中的每个用户账户或联系人显示照片，但除了 Exchange 2010 自带的命令行工具外，系统并未提供直接向存储这些图像的"thumbnailPhoto"属性上传图片的方法。AD Photo Edit 是一款用户友好的应用程序，旨在简化这些图片的上传、编辑和导出操作。

免费版功能
- 快速查看任意数量用户或联系人的现有图片，并支持按组织单位(OU)及其他属性筛选搜索结果
- 将现有图片导出为 JPG 文件
- 删除现有图片
- 向域内用户账户或联系人上传新图片（或指定连接至其他域）
- 上传前可轻松旋转、调整尺寸和优化图片质量
- 突破 Exchange 2010 命令行工具 10KB 的图片大小限制
- 兼容所有版本 Exchange Server
- 可选上传至 thumbnailPhoto 属性（供 Outlook 和 Lync 使用）或 jpegPhoto 属性（供第三方应用使用）
